audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers agreed with each other but disagreed with the packet level chart at rows 0, 5 and 6: page said Skill / Volibear / Skill where the packet says Volibear / Tryndamere / Tryndamere. The mirror audit (tryndamere__volibear) already realigned those same three rows, so leaving them here would have created a two-sided contradiction.
audit.why: Level 1 Volibear genuinely leads (Frenzied Maul re-bite heal and passive attack speed vs pre-Fury autos, and content whys[0] already said so). From first item onward Tryndamere's crit plus Bloodlust healing wins the duel and Undying Rage (120/100/80s) denies the kill — content whys[5] and whys[6] already said Tryndamere, so win[5]/win[6] were contradicting their own why text on the same page.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 5 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group, with matching ratings (6/10, 4/10, 3/10) and phases[0/5/6].why rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike text named the wrong Volibear ability as the stun and gave no cooldown for Undying Rage.
audit.why: Volibear's stun is Thundering Smash (Q, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, 300 range, auto-reset). Sky Splitter (E) slows and shields — it does not stun. Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and lasts 5s of unkillability, which is the number that makes 'wait it out' actionable.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now says Stormbringer's slow and leap set up the all-in, cites Undying Rage at 120s rank 1, and tells you to hold the Q stun for after it drops.

audit.why: The core interaction is already stated correctly across tldr, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0]: Undying Rage makes him unkillable for 5s, so the whole lane is trading on its cooldown. Frenzied Maul (W, 5s) applying on-hit and healing on the second bite of a marked target, and Sky Splitter (E, 16s) shielding only if Volibear stands in the blast, are both stated. Mocking Shout's move-speed slow only applies to targets with their backs turned, so it does not stop a Volibear who keeps facing him.
